R1-G.why: Strong premise handling (it offers a cheaper tracking-token path), keeps the service off the internet first, has a go/no-go list and a soft launch with revert triggers. It is the only plan that protects the warehouse workflow (staff auth in log mode with a revert switch, a migration with user_version after a backup, a copy of the production DB), with a concrete launch gate.
